note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the contract, its clause lines and the claim are generic placeholders, never real contract text or real claims. The two benches are identical except the one supplied scope status: in A the caliper closes on the claim (●), in B it is held apart and the open span is drawn dashed (◆) — same jaw, colour and stroke; no winner, score or outcome. No indemnity doctrine is stated: no duty to indemnify or pay, nothing decided beyond the supplied statuses, no amount unless supplied (always labelled hypothetical), no jurisdiction; "scope disputed" stays an allegation. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions, priorities, actorLabels (no actor), objectLabels and annotations; finalState = the pair of supplied scenario statuses (scenarioA / scenarioB); clauses = the shared clause lines, promise = the line on both bench cards.
